fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia (NVDA) has shown strong performance with Q3 revenue of $11.5 billion (up 103%) and net income of approximately $6.5 billion, despite recent CEO replacement controversies.
fields.summary_ko.1: The Vera Rubin platform generated $2 billion in revenue in its first quarter, raised full-year 2024 revenue growth guidance from 70% to 75%, and the current stock price is undervalued at 16x forward P/E.
